method: Entry condition: 100 m cells where >= 40% of the mangrove pixels (Global Mangrove Watch 2025) weaken by >= 1 dB/yr relative to the whole forest (|t| >= 2 per pixel, adjusted for autocorrelation, not corrected for season); touching cells are joined; patches >= 1 ha. Each patch is then checked against 4 supporting records: long-term L-band record (GMW decline zone, or GMW loss 2015-2025 over >= 5% of the patch and the 200 m around it, or ALOS-2 HV drop >= 2 dB 2015-2024 relative to the forest in >= 50% of the patch; GMW and ALOS-2 share JAXA L-band data, so they count once); Landsat NDVI drop >= 0.1 from 2015-16 to 2024-25 in >= 25%; Sentinel-1 VH drop >= 2 dB 2018-2026 relative to the forest in >= 25%; NISAR structural canopy loss in >= 10%. 'Check first' = two or more supporting records. Shown: the 8 largest, at least 500 m apart.

by_chance.method: The same alert pipeline on 20 trend maps made with the order of the passes shuffled. Measures random noise only, not season or tide.

base_rates_pct_of_forest_cells.what: Share of all 100 m forest cells that meet each supporting record on their own. The higher the share, the weaker that record is as evidence.

pct_of_candidates_meeting_each_record.what: Compare with the base rates: a record that candidates meet no more often than the forest as a whole does not single them out.

supporting_records.long_term_record: long-term L-band record (Global Mangrove Watch / ALOS-2)
